law_name: Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173)
deceased_data: Heirs and assigns may exercise data subject rights after death (s. 17; IRR ss. 34-36)
research_exemption: Personal information processed for journalistic, artistic, literary or research purposes excluded from scope, limited to that purpose (s. 4(d))
genetic_data: Sensitive personal information (s. 3(l)(2)); processing prohibited except listed cases (s. 13)
